tables.opendata_catalog: one per dataset: titles and names per language, descriptions, categories, keywords, agency, period covered, last update, links (sources), licence, attribution
tables.opendata_structures: one per dataset: dimensions, code lists, time coverage, key order, spatial reference, source
tables.opendata_structure_dims: one per dimension of a data structure
tables.opendata_terms: one per code of a code list, per language
tables.opendata_labels: one per dataset label in one language
tables.opendata_meta_reports: one per methodology or quality report
tables.opendata_document_codes: one per dimension a searchable description names
tables.opendata_documents: one per dataset's searchable description, per language
tables.opendata_passages: one per passage of a searchable description: its place, its text and its vector
tables.opendata_native_objects: one per provider response kept verbatim, by SHA-256
tables.opendata_native_bindings: one per dataset read from native objects
tables.opendata_native_exclusions: one per native reference left out, with the reason
tables.opendata_held_codes: one per dimension of a dataset: the codes holding data
